payload.scientific_question: At which exact stage did the frozen integrated controller lose every non-root BRAF-0 and BRAF-1 proposal?
payload.claim_boundary: Deterministic replay of the frozen first-round proposal streams with endpoint-level gate instrumentation; zero oracle calls; not a controller revision or docking result

route_complete_region.source: reuse sealed leave-BRAF-out route expert smoke artifact

stage_definitions.programs_attempted: calls to the frozen lane synthesizer; for route, unique ranked structural goals
stage_definitions.programs_synthesized: successful exact protected-program synthesis; for route, committed exact realizations
stage_definitions.distinct_executed_endpoints: unique canonical endpoints reaching the unchanged Fiber.check boundary
stage_definitions.independent_gate_counts: each gate evaluated independently on every distinct endpoint
stage_definitions.cumulative_funnel: parse/connectivity then representation cap then structural validity then similarity then QED then SA
stage_definitions.admitted_to_candidate_pool: unique non-root endpoints returned by the frozen production generator

closest_endpoint_order.primary: minimum maximum of similarity deficit/delta, QED deficit/0.6, and SA excess/4
closest_endpoint_order.secondary: minimum sum of the same normalized deficits

required_outputs: full per-endpoint ledgers with similarity, QED, SA, heavy-atom change, gate flags, and margins
independent and cumulative funnel counts per cell and expert
route-realization status and route shrink/pruning yield
